verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes reusable sub-workflows, modules, or the ability for one Zap/workflow to call another as a nested unit; Canvas and Workflow API references cover visual mapping and API access, not composable sub-workflows. missing for 10: documentation of a 'Sub-Zap'/nested-workflow or reusable module feature, evidence of one workflow invoking another as a callable unit, and any hands-on confirmation of this pattern.
